verdict.rationale: AWS ships both parts of the first-party IaC surface. CloudFormation provides templates that describe resources and handles provisioning and configuration (aws-docs-6). The CDK is an open-source typed framework in TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go and more, which deploys through CloudFormation to provision or update stacks (aws-docs-8, aws-docs-26, aws-docs-27). Stack-level lifecycle is documented through stack deletion (aws-docs-7) and stack membership (aws-docs-49), but rollback behavior is never described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rollback-on-failure and state/drift semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
